title: USF Source Disposition Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for the declared treatment of a source element mapped into (or excluded from) USF. Enforces the no-knowledge-loss rule: every dispositioned element links to a source reference, carries a disposition value (disposition-values), and a rationale. Governs the ontology concepts Disposition and Source Reference. A disposition is a recorded decision, not silence, and does not by itself imply implementation acceptance. lifecycleState draft; not active.

sourceRef.$comment: Link to a source reference: either an id string or an inline reference object.

targetUsfConcept.$comment: The USF concept/artefact the element maps to, or an explicit exclusion. Source path MUST NOT dictate target path.

impliesImplementationAcceptance.$comment: Disposition never confers implementation acceptance by itself.
